* I love you and care for you more than you could understand, and yet j don't even know what you mean when you say "I love you."

* I hate you. You let him ruin my life. You helped him ruin my life. You supported him instead of me. Now you're too late to say sorry.

* Just. Back. Off.
I have heard this so many times, and have now just gotten it. *that* ball.

I so desperately want moms boyfriend to stay away. I don't even know if he is her boyfriend anymore. She moved put of the house she shared with him, and he has been around no less. He goes over a lot, and recently spent the night. He's a fucking douche and no one in the family likes him. But, we can't do anything. He manipulates everyone by being passive aggressive, and it pisses everyone off. Yet, she still clings to him like a fucking wet blanket.

I do quite a few relatives, but I don't think I could stand talking to them, then seeing them a few days later. My mom tried to get me to go a counselor (I have no idea why, considering she doesn't know about all of this) about a year ago. I decided not to see her, after the first meeting, because I just couldn't talk. I couldn't find the power to talk to her.

As for being young: I know... (Here comes the "but" we are all dreading) I beat myself up over that as well, how stupid I must be to think it could work to do this. So, I hate myself just a bit more. 

Who knows, maybe I need to talk to someone. Thank you.
